info.name: Lab05 - Public API Test
info.description: Course registration API exercised with Postman/Newman

exec: pm.test("Response is an array", function () { var json = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(Array.isArray(json)).to.be.true; });
pm.test("First user name is Leanne Graham", function () { var json = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(json[0].name).to.eql("Leanne Graham"); });
